maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new instruments, biological indicators and consumables for pharma and medical customers, not repair or maintenance of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are pharma, biotech, healthcare and medical device companies; government air-monitoring buyers are a minor part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Built through a long run of acquisitions, including Agena Bioscience and Gyros Protein Technologies, plus many smaller niche brands.

mission_critical.reason: Sterilization monitoring, calibration and sensors are validated into FDA-regulated processes, so switching needs re-validation.

notes: Recurring consumables are significant, but they are used up in regulated processes, so the maintenance answer rests on judgement.
